source: Recovered complete findings from a length-truncated global GLM review; these are candidate findings, not certified facts. Some suggestions merely trade one repeated trope for another and must not be applied blindly.
editorialFindings: Multiple nearly identical lives and copied phrases remain; none of the 190 new drafts is approved for story generation.
Strong examples: library-045/library-153 repeat almost the whole domestic setup; library-055/library-059 share front-desk work and reciprocal-favour pressure.
Do not change avatar-compatible ages or genders to satisfy textual differentiation. Rewrite actual niche and relationships.

candidateCollisions.reasonZh: 同为纽约'安静技师'：二手乐器维修与出版社仓库理货，都是话少慢热、和乐手室友合租、半夜只默默戴耳塞、爱桌游、收集地铁主题小物（票/徽章），缺点逐字雷同——'聚会从不主动约，别人不叫他一个人待着还嘴上说挺好'。
candidateCollisions.suggestionZh: 保留一人；另一人改掉被动缺点与室友设定，如让110的合唱团线成为主轴、室友换成家人，收集品换成非地铁主题。
